fusions.name: Burst From Reeds
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 8 tiles to the target and bites, dealing 12 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Startled Whump
fusions.desc: Thumps your tail in a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it.

fusions.name: Startled Dash
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Pounce Pace
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your crit chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.
